custom_logic_notes: Trading logic is entirely encapsulated in the CH_HM_RSI custom signal filter class from ACH_HM_RSI.mqh. The EA uses the standard MQL5 Expert Advisor framework (CExpert/CExpertSignal) with a weighted voting system: the filter's signal value (0-100 scale) is compared against ThresholdOpen (40) and ThresholdClose (20) to decide entries and exits. The actual RSI crossover logic (RSI crossing its MA) is inside the .mqh and not visible here. Expert_EveryTick=false means processing occurs once per bar, not on every tick. SL/TP are both 0, meaning exits are purely signal-driven.
python_conversion_notes: The CH_HM_RSI signal class from ACH_HM_RSI.mqh must be read and its logic ported. It likely implements: buy when RSI crosses above its MA, sell when RSI crosses below its MA. The CExpertSignal voting/threshold mechanism must be replicated: map the filter output to a 0-100 scale, compare against open threshold (40) and close threshold (20). The Weight parameter (1.0) scales the filter's contribution. No trailing stop logic needed (TrailingNone). Position sizing is simple fixed lot. No SL/TP to implement. The EveryTick=false flag simplifies logic to per-bar evaluation.
